notes: Two routes of the same saying: Ahmad (through Ma'mar, Ash'ath) and «وقال الحسن» (Ash'ath b. Abd Allah); both meet at Abd al-Razzaq, and the tail «عن الحسن، عن عبد الله بن مغفل» is written once for both.
The «الحسن» of the tail is the second standalone occurrence of the word in the text (the Basri); it is not the Hasan b. Ali of the second route.
«قال أحمد ' ثم يتوضأ فيه ...'» is a wording variant of the same narrator, left out.
